description: Prose zero-deviation characterization versus equation

inputs.claim: Strategic deviation equals zero if and only if all firms have the same strategy.
inputs.source: DOC01 p10 Equation and following paragraph

calculation.reason: For positive SDs, D_i=0 requires the focal bank to equal each mean, not all other banks to be identical. If every bank is identical then all SD denominators vanish, leaving the displayed formula undefined without an extra convention.

notes: Logical/formula inconsistency, not evidence of any numerical-estimate mismatch. Origin supplies and labels a zero-SD operational convention.
source: DOC01 p10 Equation and following paragraph
